treatment_summary: The plan provides guideline‑directed secondary prevention after acute STEMI and addresses hypertension, CKD, and metabolic syndrome. Aspirin, clopidogrel (12 months), and high‑intensity atorvastatin replace the current low‑dose simvastatin. Ramipril and bisoprolol are initiated and up‑titrated for post‑MI cardiac protection and BP control. Dapagliflozin is added for renal and cardiovascular benefit in CKD. Amlodipine is reserved as add‑on if BP remains above target, and furosemide is prescribed PRN for congestion. All drug choices respect contraindications (no NSAIDs, verapamil, diltiazem, pioglitazone) and avoid dual RAAS blockade. Monitoring includes renal function, electrolytes, liver enzymes, lipid profile, HbA1c, BP, heart rate, weight, and symptom review per NICE NG106, NG136, CG181 and TA902/TA929.
